page.overview:
Who is Cadrin Awel?

Cadrin Awel was a female Human from the planet Vandor-3 who was romantically linked to General Stavin Thaal of the Galactic Alliance. As a teenager, Awel performed as a singer but was unable to make an impact on the galactic capital Coruscant after winning local contests on her homeworld. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, Awel and her family hid on Vandor-3 to evade notice from the Yuuzhan Vong. Before the Second Galactic Civil War, Awel established a boot camp on Vandor-3 for people to learn nature skills. Her relationship with Thaal went undocumented and she was last recorded as having married a fellow wartime survivor in 42 ABY.
